name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.natC_arityOf_le
typeText:
∀ (γ : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance) (f : Nat),
  LE.le.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.natC (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.arityOf γ f))
    (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.sizeInstance γ)

source.code:
theorem natC_arityOf_le (f : ℕ) : natC (γ.arityOf f) ≤ sizeInstance γ := by
  unfold arityOf
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge f γ.symbols.length with h | h
  · rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ h]
    exact (γ.symbol_le (List.getElem_mem h)).2
  · rw [List.getD_eq_default _ _ h]
    have := γ.seven_le_size
    show natC 0 ≤ _
    unfold natC
    simp [Nat.size_zero]
    omega
